title: Lior and the Vector
author: Sable Nakamura
blurb: Casper Crane, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
